# `type = "task"` and `type = "release"` let a stage declare INTENT and let breeze
# own the argv, so a pipeline stops hardcoding the same invocation that every repo
# spells slightly differently.
#
# They reach the engine as command stages deliberately: gates, locks, queue slots,
# adoption and survivor reaping are exactly what they need, and an engine-level
# type would fork all of it to gain nothing.
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

chmod 0755 $WORK/bin/task
chmod 0755 $WORK/bin/goreleaser

exec breeze register identity admin
cp stdout admin.token
exec breeze apply -f pipeline.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token

# breeze invokes `task <target>` — the stub records its own argv, so this asserts
# what actually ran rather than what the config said.
exec breeze start stage tooling build abc123 --as admin --token-file admin.token
stdout 'succeeded'
exec cat $WORK/argv.txt
stdout '^task build$'

# An explicit taskfile stays ONE argument even though the path contains a space.
# These argvs are assembled by breeze from config values, so a path that splits is
# a config value becoming two arguments.
exec breeze start stage tooling odd abc123 --as admin --token-file admin.token
stdout 'succeeded'
exec cat $WORK/argv.txt
stdout '^task --taskfile my tasks/Taskfile.yml lint$'

# A snapshot release must never reach goreleaser's publishing path.
exec breeze start stage tooling snap abc123 --as admin --token-file admin.token
stdout 'succeeded'
exec cat $WORK/argv.txt
stdout '^goreleaser build --snapshot --clean$'

# A task stage that names no target is refused at apply time, where someone is
# looking at the file — not at 3am when the stage runs.
! exec breeze apply -f no-target.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token
stderr 'names no target'

# An attribute that would do NOTHING is refused rather than ignored: this config
# reads as though task="build" is what runs, and it is not.
! exec breeze apply -f inert.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token
stderr 'type "command"'

exec breeze stop

-- bin/task --
#!/bin/sh
echo "task $*" > "$WORK/argv.txt"
exit 0

-- bin/goreleaser --
#!/bin/sh
echo "goreleaser $*" > "$WORK/argv.txt"
exit 0

-- pipeline.hcl --
pipeline "tooling" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "task"
    task    = "build"
    timeout = "10s"
  }
  stage "odd" {
    type     = "task"
    needs    = []
    task     = "lint"
    taskfile = "my tasks/Taskfile.yml"
    timeout  = "10s"
  }
  stage "snap" {
    type     = "release"
    needs    = []
    snapshot = true
    timeout  = "10s"
  }
}

-- no-target.hcl --
pipeline "broken" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "task"
    timeout = "10s"
  }
}

-- inert.hcl --
pipeline "inert" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
    task    = "build"
    timeout = "10s"
  }
}
